text: And Allah, Glorified and Exalted, is the deity worshipped in the heavens and the earth. And among the proofs of His divinity is that He knows all that you conceal—O people—and all that you reveal, and He knows all your deeds, whether good or evil; And for this reason, He—Glorified and Exalted—alone is the deity deserving of worship.
